Latency spiked after enabling new cache. Disabling cache restored performance. Summarize and propose next steps.

Summary
Latency increased after enabling the cache; disabling it restored performance.

Next steps
- Compare cache config (TTL/keying/eviction) before vs after
- Inspect hit rate and backend saturation during spike
- Re-enable via canary and isolate the specific setting

Risks
Re-enabling without isolating the setting can recreate the incident.

Message queue depth climbed to 500K during peak traffic. Consumer group scaled up and cleared the backlog in 40 minutes. Summarize.

Summary
Queue backlog reached 500K during peak; auto-scaling consumer group cleared it in 40 minutes.

Next steps
- Review auto-scaling trigger thresholds and cool-down periods
- Add queue depth alerting before saturation point
- Evaluate whether producer rate limiting is needed at peak

Risks
Without tuning, future peaks may exceed consumer capacity or cause downstream timeouts before scaling kicks in.
